banner.title: Measurement “{{name}}”
state.starting: play normally here: the first minute is running
state.counting: stay here and play normally — {{count}} min kept
state.countingReady: stay here and play normally — {{count}} min kept: stops as soon as it is stable
state.elsewhere: go to {{place}}: minutes only count there
state.menu: close the menu: the minute only counts if it closes quickly
state.night: new day: the measurement resumes on its own
state.config: a setting changed: the count starts over
state.patches: paused: the patch measurement is running (probe option)
state.stable: measurement done ({{count}} min): you can quit or keep playing
state.noisy: measurement done, but too noisy: replay it with less variety in places
refused.noticks: guided measurement unavailable: the game's timers aren't intercepted
config.harmony.name: Measure Harmony patches
config.harmony.tooltip: Chronometers every other mod's Harmony patches (opt-in). Takes effect at the next launch of the game; a guided measurement or a benchmark disarms it for the session.
config.textures.name: Measure resident textures
config.textures.tooltip: Tracks the memory kept in loaded textures, by provider (opt-in). Takes effect at the next launch of the game.
